mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_behavior(user_id,item_id,action,value,scene,bucket,exposure_id,ts) VALUES(#{userId},#{itemId},#{action},#{value},#{scene},#{bucket},#{exposureId},#{timestamp}) ON CONFLICT (exposure_id) WHERE action='CLICK' AND exposure_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT bucket FROM user_behavior WHERE exposure_id=#{exposureId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND item_id=#{itemId} AND action='IMPRESSION' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
